messages:
support-ojas: heads up — Acme (acct-873) opened a high-priority ticket: large import triggered a surge of 504s & some 403s around 2025-08-03T14:12Z. customer says requests queued ~30s then gateway returned 504. they saw intermittent 'quota exceeded' / auth failures as well. blocking their import.

eng-oncall-maya: oncall — can we get an example request id + sample curl from the customer and any gateway traces?

customer-james: sharing timeline from our side. we fired ~120 concurrent generate calls at 14:11:58Z. sample:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-XXXX"
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: acct-873"
  -d '{"model":"gpt-open-1","input":"Import users batch 423"}'
```
most replies were 200 but ~18% were 504 starting ~14:12:30 for ~6 minutes. customer also captured a few 403s and some 'quota exceeded' in their client logs.

sre-evan: infra notes so far: KEDA scaledobject fired but many pods failed readiness / stuck initialising. kube events include pull/backoff and mount errors around the window:
```
Warning FailedMount pod/runner-acct-873-5cf MountVolume.SetUp failed for volume
Warning BackOff pod/runner-acct-873-5cf Back-off restarting failed container
Normal Created pod/runner-acct-873-5cf
```
model binary init measured ~28-32s on heavy variant. readiness probe failing repeatedly -> fewer ready replicas than expected.

billing-ryan: spotted a billing/key rotation at 14:10:50Z that briefly caused edge auth checks to return 403 while caches updated. if clients retry aggressively, that can amplify traffic into the scaler.

eng-oncall-maya: hypothesis: short auth blips (403) + coldstart policy (min=0, long cooldown) + tight readiness thresholds -> request pileup at gateway -> timeouts -> 504. we need a reproducer request id to pull trace. Ojas, any rid?

support-ojas: provided rid r_20250803_acct873_009 and uploaded customer logs to the ticket.

sre-evan: grabbed scaledobject + hpa for acct-873:
```yaml
ScaledObject: acct-873-scaledobj
  minReplicaCount: 0
  cooldownPeriod: 240  # long by default for this setup
  pollingInterval: 30
HPA: targetCPU 50% current 3% -> didn't ramp as expected
```
KEDA min 0 + cooldown 240s = cold starts. combined with model init ~30s and readiness failureThreshold=3 -> slow to reach route-ready capacity.

product-zoe: we need fast mitigations and long-term safeguards. what can we change now?

eng-oncall-maya: immediate mitigations (ordered):
- bump scaledobject minReplicaCount to 2 for acct-873 (pre-warm)
- shorten cooldownPeriod to 60s
- temporarily relax readiness failureThreshold from 3->5 to avoid flapping while model init variance stabilises
- add an ingress fallback route for acct-873 to a faster-warm model variant (smaller weights) while heavy variant spins up
- coordinate with Billing to pause/rollback the key rotation propagation if auth 403s still occur
I'll apply the scaledobject change and watch.

sre-evan: applying patch (staging -> prod):
```bash
kubectl patch scaledobject acct-873-scaledobj --type='merge' -p '{"spec": {"minReplicaCount": 2, "cooldownPeriod": 60}}'
kubectl patch deployment runner-acct-873 --type='json' -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/livenessProbe/failureThreshold","value":5}]'
```
will tail events and pods. also increasing readiness probe initialDelay to avoid false negatives during heavy init.

billing-ryan: rolling forward a quick fix on the rotation: paused propagation to edge caches and re-did a canary push. auth 403s should subside in ~2-3m. i will add a guard for rotations when tenant traffic > threshold.

deploy-bot: Deployment runner-acct-873 scaled from 0 -> 3 replicas (2025-08-03T14:26:18Z)

sre-evan: after the changes we saw cold pod count go from 0 to 2 baseline, and warmup latency reduced. 504 rate dropped from ~18% -> ~3% within 5 minutes. still rare slow init spikes for a tiny subset of heavy-variant requests.

customer-james: confirmed the import resumed and 504s dropped to near zero after your patch. huge relief. can we get a durable plan?

product-zoe: long-term actions proposed:
- offer a Prewarm SLO or reserved runner option for heavy batch imports (documented product path)
- change default scaledobject template for interactive/real-time endpoints to minReplicaCount >=1 and cooldown <=120s
- add a back-off tuned ingress retry (client-sensible) and circuit-breaker in gateway to avoid cascade retries from auth blips
- warnings in billing UI when rotating keys for high-traffic tenants; gate rotations behind canary propagation
I'll file tickets and prioritize the defaults change.

sre-evan: root-cause summary for postmortem: transient auth cache/rotation (403s) induced retries + autoscaler configured with minReplicaCount=0 and long cooldown + readiness thresholds that penalised variable model init times -> insufficient ready capacity during a concentrated tenant burst -> gateway request timeouts (504).

support-ojas: updating customer ticket with mitigation steps taken and ETA for product changes. assigning follow-ups: Product (zoe), SRE (evan), Billing (ryan).

eng-oncall-maya: thanks all. tagging @here for visibility. close when Product files the defaults ticket and Billing adds the rotation guard. :white_check_mark:
